title: Free Datasets for Any AI Project: Awesome Public Datasets on GitHub
description:
Ever tried building a dashboard with real data and your AI agent just stops and asks "where's the data from?" 😅 Theres a GitHub repo, Awesome Public Datasets, with hundreds of free datasets: climate, finance, sports, movies, cities. All sorted, links actualy checked and working ✨ Grab a URL, hand it to your agent, and your project moving again 🔥

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
